summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the rod groups and proportions, negations, repentance conditions, differing dwelling outcomes, and death warnings. The notes distinguish the working editorial conjecture from the reported Athos reading and accurately disclose the supplied bounded reports concerning Michigan’s alternatives and gaps. Acceptance is limited to the supplied working source and evidence reports; it does not authenticate unseen images, certify editions or handwriting, or establish exhaustive manuscript agreement.
